## Annotation

This is a later reference point, not a substitute for 1990s primary sources.

The introduction (page 1, opened as an image) dates CSIL only as “the 1990's”:

> Participation in the program has grown annually since its establishment in the 1990's

That sentence does **not** choose 1993 versus 1994. This archive must not use the 2008 synthesis to pick a starting year.

What the opened pages and the IA OCR of the same item can support:

- That a November 2008 *Program Review* / *Synthesis Report* prepared by James Murtagh Consulting for the Home and Community Care Branch exists and is inspectable online as this Microlog fiche.
- That the authors present the report as a synthesis of recent, relatively independent CSIL review efforts (the introduction and section 2 describe a 2006 Ministry of Health Services review that produced background papers but “no final report,” plus other 2006 reviews).
- That *Best of Care* footnote 207’s short title and November 2008 date match this cover.

What they do **not** settle:

- The *Best of Care* statement that “The CSIL program underwent a provincial review in 2007.” The inspected 2008 synthesis describes a **2006** ministry review and is dated November 2008. This archive still does not treat “2007 provincial review” and this November 2008 synthesis as proven to be the same product.
- Founding-year questions (1993 versus 1994; pilot versus province-wide).
- Redistribution of the IA PDF (ProQuest fiche copyright notice; no hosting licence seen).

Do not confuse this item with the 2012 Foerster & Murtagh **Care Aide and Community Health Worker Registry** review (FOI HTH-2012-00165), which is a different program and year.

## Open questions

- Whether *Best of Care*’s “provincial review in 2007” is this synthesis, the 2006 ministry process, a contract year, or another product.
- A born-digital ministry file separate from the Microlog scan, if one exists.
- Place of publication (not on the title pages opened; IA catalogue only).
- Day within November 2008.
- Independent confirmation of the IA metadata OCLC number.
- The other review documents this synthesis cites (named in OCR; not separately catalogued here). Those may become new wanted items.
